verdicts.reason: A uses the tall canvas, but the headline is small and the characters are scattered with large dead areas. MERRY and DISCOUNT are separated by a big gap, and the bottom row of characters looks sparse and disconnected. B keeps the original composition shrunk into a thin horizontal band, with huge empty areas above and below and tiny text. That is the classic shrink-not-rearrange failure, though the cluster is cohesive and the headline and subline sit close together. Both are weak; A at least rearranges and fills the format more.
